notes: imd/acc on Ethereum mainnet, second launch: one contract, the ProjectRegistry, the list of projects whose cashback earns points, decided by IdentityMD oracle panels through Intake v2 (0xa43e...de82), paid in IMD (0xd34a...63b7). It names the live mainnet Stacker 0x0690...f4f0 (launch #1409) in its questions and never calls it; the Stacker is not redeployed. The code of Sepolia test run 5 (launch #1428) with one rule text clarified: version 3.1 of the panel rules (docs/panel-rules-v2.md; the trader rule rejects the router itself and accepts a contract the router's msgSender() reports) and owner-only applications (a project that reports an owner() is applied for by that owner or itself; NotProjectOwner otherwise). Settings agreed by the owner: challenge bond 20 IMD, challenge cooldown 7 days (604800 s); panel 15 seats with 11 agreeing and a 1-day expiry are constants. Each ask pays the oracle fee read live from the Intake (ORACLE_FEE(), 0.5 IMD). Answers are accepted only from the Intake, for its own open request, signed by the oracle signer 0x5598...2982 for this contract, within mainnet's 200,000 callback gas. A listed project's beneficiary may hand its points to another wallet at most once per day and never while a question is open. Settling or clearing a question never waits on paying a bond: a refused transfer is recorded in bondOwed and claimed with claimBond(to). Questions are filed under chain 1. No owner; its constructor makes no external call. Test doubles under test/mocks and test/trial are not deployed.
